name: ORBIT 2022
description: In this work, we present the winning solution for ORBIT Few-Shot Video Object Recognition Challenge 2022. Built upon the ProtoNet baseline, the performance of our method is improved with three effective techniques. These techniques include the embedding adaptation, the uniform video clip sampler and the invalid frame detection. In addition, we re-factor and re-implement the official codebase to encourage modularity, compatibility and improved performance. Our implementation accelerates the data loading in both training and testing.
reputation: A challenge benchmark in few-shot video object recognition that is mainly used in the ORBIT competition and related few-shot video recognition research.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; few-shot setting with small support sets and video-specific variability, so results can be sensitive to sampling and implementation details.
